response.cue_rationale: “To shop as an activity” matches both answers and distinguishes the activity from a specific purchase or spending amount.

preference_risk.rationale: Berbelanja exists in Malaysian Malay and may be used for shopping or spending, though membeli-belah remains a useful standard preference for this sense.

response.rationale: Both forms naturally express the activity of shopping. “Berbelanja” is the ordinary Indonesian choice, while Malaysian Malay commonly uses “membeli-belah”; this is a useful variety preference rather than an exclusive distinction.
response.risk_rationale: “Belanja/berbelanja” can also suggest spending money, so context may affect interpretation.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: “Berbelanja” is also understandable and used in Malaysian Malay, but “membeli-belah” is the clearer established Malaysian preference for shopping as an activity; this does not defeat the contrast.
